description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil C++ library's PCG engine implementations, including golden value checks, seed and discard tests, serialization, and interface compliance.

classes.name: PCGEngineTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for PCG engine types, including specific tests for reseeding, discarding, serialization, and interface compliance.

methods.name: VerifyReseedChangesAllValues
methods.description: Tests that reseeding the engine with different seed sequences produces uncorrelated outputs and changes all internal state values.

methods.name: VerifyDiscard
methods.description: Tests that discarding a number of outputs results in the same subsequent outputs as re-generating after discarding.

methods.name: StreamOperatorsResult
methods.description: Checks that stream insertion and extraction operators work correctly with the engine.

methods.name: StreamSerialization
methods.description: Verifies that engine state can be serialized to and deserialized from a stream, and that outputs remain consistent.

methods.name: RandomNumberEngineInterface
methods.description: Ensures the engine meets the C++ random number engine interface requirements, including copy/move semantics and operator behaviors.

methods.name: RandenEngineSFINAETest
methods.description: Tests that engine construction and seeding are SFINAE-friendly, allowing various argument types.

methods.name: VerifyGolden
methods.description: Checks that the engine produces expected golden outputs for specific seeds, ensuring reproducibility.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenSeeded
methods.description: Checks that the engine produces expected outputs when seeded with a seed sequence.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenFromDeserializedEngine
methods.description: Verifies that a deserialized engine produces the same sequence of outputs as a freshly seeded engine.
